value.rationale: A qualitative countable attractor does not determine physical switching frequency. The proof classifies that frequency for all positive-height admissible initial states and makes contact order a universal quantitative invariant, including an exact parabolic integer law. The parameter p corresponds to the order of tangency of a switching boundary, not an arbitrary isolated sample.
